name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
description: Annex A controls — 93 controls across 4 themes (37 organizational, 8 people, 14 physical, 34 technological).

controls.name: Policies for information security
controls.req: Define, approve, publish and review an information security policy and topic-specific policies.

controls.name: Information security roles and responsibilities
controls.req: Assign and communicate IS roles and responsibilities to all employees and relevant third parties.

controls.name: Segregation of duties
controls.req: Separate conflicting duties and areas of responsibility to reduce unauthorized activity risk.

controls.name: Management responsibilities
controls.req: Management requires all personnel to apply the information security policy per their role.

controls.name: Contact with authorities
controls.req: Establish and maintain contacts with relevant authorities (e.g. CERT-In, law enforcement).

controls.name: Contact with special interest groups
controls.req: Maintain contacts with security forums and professional groups for threat intelligence sharing.

controls.name: Threat intelligence
controls.req: Collect and analyze threat intelligence to produce actionable information on threats.

controls.name: Information security in project management
controls.req: Integrate IS risk management into project lifecycle management.

controls.name: Inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.req: Maintain and review an inventory of information and associated assets with owners.

controls.name: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
controls.req: Define rules for acceptable use and handling of information and assets.

controls.name: Return of assets
controls.req: Ensure personnel and third parties return organization assets on termination/change of engagement.

controls.name: Classification of information
controls.req: Classify information by sensitivity and label per the organization's classification scheme.

controls.name: Labelling of information
controls.req: Apply and remove labels per the chosen classification and labelling scheme.

controls.name: Information transfer
controls.req: Apply controls to protect information transferred within and outside the organization (NDA, encryption).

controls.name: Access control
controls.req: Establish rules for physical and logical access based on business and IS requirements.

controls.name: Identity management
controls.req: Manage the full lifecycle of identities (onboarding, changes, offboarding) of users and systems.

controls.name: Authentication information
controls.req: Allocate and manage authentication information securely (MFA, password policy, no shared creds).

controls.name: Access rights
controls.req: Review, adjust and remove access rights (least privilege, periodic review, revocation within SLA).

controls.name: Information security in supplier relationships
controls.req: Define and agree IS requirements with suppliers (SLA, security clauses) before engagement.

controls.name: Addressing IS within supplier agreements
controls.req: Include IS requirements in supplier agreements and review them periodically.

controls.name: Managing IS in the ICT supply chain
controls.req: Manage risks in the ICT supply chain, including software quality, updates and secure development.

controls.name: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
controls.req: Monitor, review and audit supplier service delivery and changes against agreements.

controls.name: IS for use of cloud services
controls.req: Define acquisition, use, management and exiting of cloud services per security requirements.

controls.name: IS incident management planning and preparation
controls.req: Plan, prepare and assign roles for incident response incl. procedures, tools and exercises.

controls.name: Assessment and decision on IS events
controls.req: Assess IS events and decide whether they are incidents.

controls.name: Response to IS incidents
controls.req: Respond per the incident management plan: containment, eradication, recovery, communication.

controls.name: Learning from IS incidents
controls.req: Extract lessons learned, feed back into controls, and use knowledge to improve.

controls.name: Collection of evidence
controls.req: Collect, preserve and present evidence in a legally admissible manner (chain of custody).

controls.name: IS during disruption
controls.req: Maintain appropriate level of IS during disruptions (backup, DR aligned with BCM).

controls.name: ICT readiness for business continuity
controls.req: Plan ICT continuity based on BCM objectives, incl. redundancy and recovery times.

controls.name: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
controls.req: Identify, document and comply with legal/regulatory/contractual IS requirements.

controls.name: Intellectual property rights
controls.req: Protect IPR (licenses for software, media content).

controls.name: Protection of records
controls.req: Protect records from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access and disclosure (retention + integrity).

controls.name: Privacy and protection of PII
controls.req: Identify and comply with privacy legislation requirements (e.g. DPDP Act 2023).

controls.name: Independent review of IS
controls.req: Review the IS management approach independently at planned intervals (internal/external audit).

controls.name: Compliance with policies, rules and standards for IS
controls.req: Comply with internal policies and standards; verify compliance regularly.

controls.name: Documented operating procedures
controls.req: Document operating procedures for information processing facilities and keep them available.

controls.name: Screening
controls.req: Verify background checks for candidates before employment, per policy and regulations.

controls.name: Terms and conditions of employment
controls.req: Include IS roles and responsibilities in contractual terms (code of conduct, confidentiality).

controls.name: IS awareness, education and training
controls.req: Deliver security awareness, education and training tailored to job function, at hire and regularly.

controls.name: Disciplinary process
controls.req: Have a formal, communicated disciplinary process for policy violations.

controls.name: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
controls.req: Define and enforce responsibilities and duties after termination (asset return, access revocation).

controls.name: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
controls.req: Use NDAs reflecting the organization's needs for protecting information.

controls.name: Remote working
controls.req: Protect information accessed, processed and stored at remote locations (secure access, device policy).

controls.name: IS event reporting
controls.req: Provide a mechanism for personnel to report observed or suspected IS events promptly.

controls.name: Physical security perimeters
controls.req: Define security perimeters to protect areas containing information and assets.

controls.name: Physical entry
controls.req: Control entry to secure areas with appropriate access controls.

controls.name: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
controls.req: Design offices/rooms/facilities physically secure per risk.

controls.name: Physical security monitoring
controls.req: Continuously monitor secure areas (alarms, CCTV, guards).

controls.name: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
controls.req: Protect against threats like fire, flood, earthquake, explosions (detection + suppression).

controls.name: Working in secure areas
controls.req: Apply rules for working in secure areas (restricted activities, supervision, recorded visits).

controls.name: Clear desk and clear screen
controls.req: Apply clear desk/clear screen rules (secure unattended documents and endpoints).

controls.name: Equipment siting and protection
controls.req: Sit and protect equipment to reduce environmental and access risks.

controls.name: Security of assets off-premises
controls.req: Protect off-premises assets (laptops, mobile, removable media) with equivalent controls.

controls.name: Storage media
controls.req: Manage the lifecycle of storage media (acquisition, use, transport, disposal).

controls.name: Supporting utilities
controls.req: Protect supporting utilities (power, cooling, comms) from failure (redundancy, UPS).

controls.name: Cabling security
controls.req: Protect power and data cabling from interception and damage.

controls.name: Equipment maintenance
controls.req: Maintain equipment per manufacturer specifications and retention of records.

controls.name: Secure disposal or reuse of equipment
controls.req: Verify equipment/medium disposal and reuse performed securely (data erasure, degauss).

controls.name: User endpoint devices
controls.req: Protect information on user devices (policy, patch, encryption, MDM).

controls.name: Privileged access rights
controls.req: Restrict and manage privileged access rights (dedicated admin accounts, review).

controls.name: Information access restriction
controls.req: Restrict information access per access control policy (need-to-know, least privilege).

controls.name: Access to source code
controls.req: Restrict access to source code (separate environments, version control access control).

controls.name: Secure authentication
controls.req: Implement secure authentication technologies and procedures (MFA, passwordless, session controls).

controls.name: Capacity management
controls.req: Monitor and manage capacity to meet performance and growth needs.

controls.name: Protection against malware
controls.req: Implement malware protection (AV/EDR, egress filtering, awareness).

controls.name: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.req: Discover and remediate technical vulnerabilities (scans, patch management, SLAs by severity).

controls.name: Configuration management
controls.req: Manage configurations incl. baselines, changes and review of security settings.

controls.name: Information deletion
controls.req: Delete information when no longer needed per retention schedule; document secure deletion.

controls.name: Data masking
controls.req: Apply data masking techniques aligned with access control policy and business needs.

controls.name: Data leakage prevention
controls.req: Prevent and detect unauthorized data leakage (DLP on data at rest, in motion, in use).

controls.name: Information backup
controls.req: Back up information, software and systems per agreed schedule; test restores regularly.

controls.name: Redundancy of information processing facilities
controls.req: Provide redundant processing facilities meeting availability requirements.

controls.name: Logging
controls.req: Log user activities, exceptions, faults and IS events; retain per policy; protect logs from tampering.

controls.name: Monitoring activities
controls.req: Monitor systems, networks and user activity for effectiveness and anomalies.

controls.name: Clock synchronization
controls.req: Synchronize clocks of information processing systems to a trusted time source.

controls.name: Use of privileged utility programs
controls.req: Restrict and tightly control use of privileged utilities (debuggers, sys internals).

controls.name: Installation of software on operational systems
controls.req: Control software installation on operational systems (approved catalog, least privilege).

controls.name: Networks security
controls.req: Secure networks and network services (segmentation, firewalls, monitoring).

controls.name: Security of network services
controls.req: Define and implement security mechanisms for network services (MSSP, VPN, filtering).

controls.name: Segregation of networks
controls.req: Segregate networks (DMZ, internal zones, OT isolation, guest Wi-Fi).

controls.name: Web filtering
controls.req: Manage access to external websites (category-based filtering, DGA/blocklist checks).

controls.name: Use of cryptography
controls.req: Define and apply cryptographic controls (ciphersuites, key lifecycle, HSM for high assurance).

controls.name: Secure development lifecycle
controls.req: Establish rules for secure development (SDL: threat modeling, secure coding, review).

controls.name: Application security requirements
controls.req: Identify and document security requirements during requirements phase.

controls.name: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
controls.req: Apply secure architecture principles (defense in depth, least privilege) to new systems.

controls.name: Secure coding
controls.req: Define and apply secure coding principles (input validation, OWASP ASVS alignment).

controls.name: Security testing in development and acceptance
controls.req: Test security during development and acceptance (SAST, DAST, dependency scans).

controls.name: Outsourced development
controls.req: Manage security of outsourced development (vendor controls, IP rights in code).

controls.name: Separation of development, test and production
controls.req: Separate development, test and production environments (no direct prod data in test).

controls.name: Change management
controls.req: Apply change management to changes in systems, services and processes (approval, rollback).

controls.name: Test information
controls.req: Use information that is appropriately protected for testing; avoid real PII; mask.

controls.name: Protection of IS during audit testing
controls.req: Plan and approve audit/testing activities to minimize impact on production operations.
